changeSet.comment: Create ONE pregnancy cycle per patient who does not already have one
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO pmtct_pregnancy_cycle ( person_uuid, maternal_outcome, entry_point, hiv_status, pregnancy_outcome, number_of_infants, pmtct_status, facility_id, created_by, created_date, last_modified_by, last_modified_date, uuid, archived, is_closed ) WITH all_patients AS ( SELECT DISTINCT person_uuid FROM pmtct_anc WHERE person_uuid IS NOT NULL UNION SELECT DISTINCT person_uuid FROM pmtct_enrollment WHERE person_uuid IS NOT NULL ), latest_anc AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (person_uuid) person_uuid, id, anc_no, static_hiv_status, status, facility_id, created_by, created_date, last_modified_by, last_modified_date, archived FROM pmtct_anc WHERE person_uuid IS NOT NULL ORDER BY person_uuid, created_date DESC NULLS LAST, id DESC ), latest_enrollment AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (person_uuid) person_uuid, id, anc_no, hiv_status, entry_point, facility_id, created_by, created_date, last_modified_by, last_modified_date, archived FROM pmtct_enrollment WHERE person_uuid IS NOT NULL ORDER BY person_uuid, created_date DESC NULLS LAST, id DESC ), latest_hts AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (person_uuid) person_uuid, final_result FROM pmtct_hts WHERE person_uuid IS NOT NULL ORDER BY person_uuid, id DESC ), latest_delivery AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (person_uuid) person_uuid, child_status, maternal_outcome, number_of_infants_alive, number_of_infants_dead FROM pmtct_delivery WHERE person_uuid IS NOT NULL ORDER BY person_uuid, created_date DESC NULLS LAST, id DESC ) SELECT ap.person_uuid, d.maternal_outcome as maternal_outcome, CASE WHEN a.id IS NOT NULL THEN 'ANC' WHEN e.entry_point = 'PMTCT_ENTRY_POINT_ANC' THEN 'ANC' WHEN e.entry_point = 'PMTCT_ENTRY_POINT_POST-PARTUM' THEN 'Post-partum' WHEN e.entry_point = 'PMTCT_ENTRY_POINT_LD' THEN 'LD' WHEN e.entry_point IS NOT NULL THEN e.entry_point ELSE 'ANC' END as entry_point, COALESCE( e.hiv_status, hts.final_result, a.static_hiv_status ) as hiv_status, d.child_status as pregnancy_outcome, COALESCE(d.number_of_infants_alive, 0) + COALESCE(d.number_of_infants_dead, 0) as number_of_infants, 'ACTIVE' as pmtct_status, COALESCE(a.facility_id, e.facility_id) as facility_id, COALESCE(a.created_by, e.created_by) as created_by, COALESCE(a.created_date, e.created_date) as created_date, COALESCE(a.last_modified_by, e.last_modified_by) as last_modified_by, COALESCE(a.last_modified_date, e.last_modified_date, a.created_date, e.created_date) as last_modified_date, gen_random_uuid() as uuid, COALESCE(a.archived, e.archived, 0) as archived, CASE WHEN d.maternal_outcome IN ( 'MATERNAL_OUTCOME_DEAD', 'MATERNAL_OUTCOME_LOST_TO_FOLLOW-UP', 'MATERNAL_OUTCOME_TRANSFERRED_OUT' ) THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END as is_closed FROM all_patients ap LEFT JOIN latest_anc a ON ap.person_uuid = a.person_uuid LEFT JOIN latest_enrollment e ON ap.person_uuid = e.person_uuid LEFT JOIN latest_hts hts ON ap.person_uuid = hts.person_uuid LEFT JOIN latest_delivery d ON ap.person_uuid = d.person_uuid WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM pmtct_pregnancy_cycle pc WHERE pc.person_uuid = ap.person_uuid ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM patient_person pp WHERE pp.uuid = ap.person_uuid );

changeSet.author: system
changeSet.sql: UPDATE pmtct_pregnancy_cycle pc SET number_of_infants = infant_count.total FROM ( SELECT i.mother_person_uuid, COUNT(DISTINCT i.id) as total, MIN(i.created_date) as first_created FROM pmtct_infant_information i WHERE i.mother_person_uuid IS NOT NULL GROUP BY i.mother_person_uuid ) infant_count WHERE pc.person_uuid = infant_count.mother_person_uuid AND ABS(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (infant_count.first_created - pc.created_date))) < 31536000 AND infant_count.total > COALESCE(pc.number_of_infants, 0);
